name: GrantSignal US
description: Turns current Grants.gov opportunity records into structured search, detail, applicant-fit and research-brief responses for agents.
notes: Submission cited POST /v1/grants/preflight as the live 402 route, but that route validates its body before the payment gate and answers 400 to an unpaid probe. /v1/grants/search returns a clean 402 and is used as the probe instead.
The published manifest at /.well-known/x402 advertises its resources on host genuinegood.online, not the submitted greatergood.site.

name: AutoYT Provider Stack Optimizer
description: Deterministic provider-stack routing for AI/video production: stage-by-stage route, expected cost and latency, reliability-adjusted quality and ranked fallbacks.
notes: Brokered through the FiatDock marketplace; the 402 is served by the marketplace gateway, which reported feeBps=0 at check time.

name: GF Agent Toll
description: GCC ecommerce decision tools (landed cost, opportunity score, product decision, portfolio rank, merchant pack) over HTTP, MCP, A2A and x402.
notes: Like GrantSignal, this endpoint validates the request body before the payment gate: a malformed body answers 400, not 402. The probe body above matches the published OpenAPI example.
Priced tiers run $0.25 to $12.00; the probe covers the $0.25 landed-cost route.

name: Agent Earn Radar

notes: The whole Vercel deployment is gone: the paid route, the free preview and the site root all answer 404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND. Re-check once the submitter redeploys.
